lines.t: All foreigners sojourning in Israel were counted as
lines.ru: Пришельцами считались все иноземцы, жившие в Израиле

lines.t: Under the care and protection of God
Very numerous in Solomon’s reign
lines.ru: Были весьма многочисленны в царствование Соломона

lines.t: Chiefly consisted of
The remnant of the mixed multitude who came out of Egypt
lines.ru: Остатка разноплеменного народа, вышедшего из Египта

lines.t: The remnant of the nations of the land
Captives taken in war
Foreign servants
Persons who sought employment among the Jews
Persons who came into Israel for the sake of religious privileges
lines.ru: Людей, пришедших в Израиль ради благ истинной веры

lines.t: Laws respecting
Not to practise idolatrous rites
Not to blaspheme God
Not to eat blood
Not to eat the passover while uncircumcised
Not to work on the Sabbath
Not to be vexed or oppressed
lines.ru: Их не притеснять и не угнетать

lines.t: Not to be chosen as kings in Israel
lines.ru: Их не избирать царями в Израиле

lines.t: To be loved
To be relieved in distress
Subject to the civil law
To have justice done to them in all disputes
lines.ru: Им оказывать правосудие во всех тяжбах

lines.t: To enjoy the benefit of the cities of refuge
To have the gleaning of the harvest
To participate in the rejoicings of the people
To have the law read to them
The Jews might purchase and have them as slaves
lines.ru: Иудеи могли покупать их и держать в рабстве

lines.t: The Jews might take usury from
lines.ru: Иудеи могли брать с них рост

lines.t: Might purchase Hebrew servants subject to release
lines.ru: Могли покупать еврейских слуг, которые подлежали выкупу

lines.t: Might offer their burnt-offerings on the altar of God
lines.ru: Могли приносить свои всесожжения на жертвеннике Божием

lines.t: Allowed to eat what died of itself
Motives urged on the Jews for being kind to
lines.ru: Побуждения, внушавшиеся иудеям, к доброму обращению с ними

lines.t: Admitted to worship in the outer court of the temple
lines.ru: Допускались к поклонению во внешнем дворе храма

lines.t: Were frequently employed in public works
The Jews condemned for oppressing
